summary_en: 19,000,000 shares (13.81% of S/O) acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥513/share (prior close); ¥11.0B upper limit; settlement 2026-08-31. Includes shares from controlling shareholder Hisako Uemura (held <10% post-transaction) and open participation from other shareholders.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and share purchases via off-exchange transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-28, Tohokushinsha Film Corporation's board resolved to acquire up to 19,000,000 treasury shares (13.81% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥11.0 billion via ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange transaction. The acquisition will be executed on 2026-08-31 at the prior close price of ¥513 per share. The block was initiated following consultation with controlling shareholder Hisako Uemura regarding partial divestiture of her holdings. Unlike a typical controlling-shareholder reduction, the company structured the buyback to accept share offers from all shareholders, not solely the controlling shareholder. The company identifies four benefits: (1) enhanced shareholder returns through expanded sale opportunity for minority shareholders; (2) improved capital efficiency metrics including ROE through equity base compression; (3) increased free float ratio—currently at 25.01% (TSE Standard maintenance threshold) partly due to 3D WH Opportunity Holdings' 18.70% stake being treated as liquid—with Uemura's holdings becoming liquid post-reduction (her stake drops below 10%), creating buffer against 3D reclassification; and (4) mitigation of market supply-demand imbalance that would occur if Uemura's large block were market-sold in short timeframe. The filing notes all shares acquired will be treasury; no immediate cancellation is announced.
